## Contract contents

- Protocol version: `1.0`.
- Max frame bytes: `1000000`.
- Max prompt chars: `100000`.
- Frame types (13): `auth`, `auth_ok`, `auth_err`, `infer`, `result`, `error`, `chunk`, `ping`, `pong`, `cancel`, `provider_hello`, `provider_status`, `image_broadcast`.
- Error codes (6): `OFFLINE`, `TIMEOUT`, `OLLAMA_ERROR`, `AUTH_FAILED`, `BUSY`, `PROTOCOL_ERROR`.
- Allowed option keys (7): `temperature`, `num_predict`, `num_ctx`, `top_p`, `top_k`, `stop`, `seed`.
- Shared wire fixtures: `13` entries in `central-server/src/test/resources/wire-fixtures.json`.

## Drift result

`make wire-gen` was executed in this task. Pre/post SHA-256 hashes of `protocol/wire-contract.json`, `WireContractGenerated.kt`, and `_wire_contract_generated.py` were identical, and `git diff -- protocol/wire-contract.json ...generated... scripts/gen_wire_contract.py` printed no generated-file diff. Therefore no manually edited generated artifact is currently detected in the worktree.

## Verification commands

- Regenerate: `make wire-gen`.
- Drift check only: `make wire-check`.
- Full cross-language contract: `make contract`.
- NEXA wrapper: `./scripts/nexa-verify.sh contracts` (alias of `protocol`).
- PowerShell wrapper: `./scripts/nexa-verify.ps1 contracts` (alias of `protocol`).

The graph originally listed `./scripts/nexa-verify.sh contracts`, while the wrapper exposed only `protocol`; T019 adds the minimal `contracts` alias in both shell and PowerShell wrappers so the declared task verification command is executable. This is a KISS/YAGNI compatibility alias, not a second verification path.

## Manual-edit prohibition

1. Do not directly edit `central-server/.../WireContractGenerated.kt` or `provider-agent/.../_wire_contract_generated.py`. Both files carry `DO NOT EDIT` headers and are derived from `protocol/wire-contract.json`.
2. Any wire constant change must update `protocol/wire-contract.json`, run `make wire-gen`, review generated diffs in both languages, then run `make contract`.
3. If frame JSON shapes change, update `central-server/src/test/resources/wire-fixtures.json` in the same change and keep the Kotlin `WireContractTest` plus Python `provider-agent/tests/test_contract.py` green.
4. If protocol package paths move, update `scripts/gen_wire_contract.py` output paths and this baseline together; otherwise generated-code drift guards will check the wrong files.

Because T019 depends on T018 and T018 is still dependency-gated `REVIEW`, this task should remain `REVIEW` after automated verification. It can move to `VERIFIED` only after upstream gates are approved or the task graph dependency is revised.
